title: Demo Day — Founder Conviction Stage
description: A stripped-back hero engineered for YC-style demo days: punchy two-line problem statement at the top, company name and product descriptor centered in display sans, and a YC-orange accent strip anchoring the foot with batch tag and date. No filler, no gradients — just signal.
philosophy: This template exists because founders routinely bury their strongest asset — the problem statement — beneath decorative chrome and stock photography. Demo Day — Founder Conviction Stage refuses illustration, texture, and secondary color by design. It believes one saturated accent strip does more persuasive work than any background treatment, and that strict vertical symmetry forces every word to earn its place. It is built for a room of investors who have seen a thousand hero slides and will remember exactly one.
goodFor: YC-style batch demo day opening slides
avoidFor: Brand identity decks requiring full multi-color palette expression
Narrative slide sequences needing more than a single hero moment
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide should feel like a founder stepping to center stage — charged anticipation, zero decoration. Compositional gravity runs between the blunt problem statement anchoring the top and the saturated accent strip locking the foot, with the company name suspended in clean negative space between. Avoid any softness: no gradients, no texture, no illustrative motifs — all drama lives in scale contrast and a single chromatic punch. Surgical conviction: everything stripped, what remains cannot be ignored.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid; all live text occupies the center 8 columns (cols 3–10) with roughly 10% outer horizontal margins. Vertical structure divides into three bands: problem statement in the upper third, company name and product descriptor centered in the middle third, and a full-bleed accent strip capping the bottom ~8% of slide height — batch tag flush left, date flush right inside it. Hierarchy is enforced by size contrast alone: no rule lines, no decorative dividers, no header band, and no slide number outside the strip zone.

examples.promptCore: Feels like a founder dropping hard evidence in a roomful of skeptics — spare, declarative, zero ornamentation. The compositional rhythm is dense-horizontal in the stat row, then exhales into the quieter supporting line below, creating a one-two punch rather than a list. A single saturated accent strip at the base anchors the slide the way a period ends a sentence: final and unambiguous. Avoid any softening gestures — no rounded containers, no illustrative elements, no tonal background washes — this slide should feel like it was carved, not decorated.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-col grid with an 8% outer margin on each side; content occupies cols 2–11. Slide is split into two horizontal bands: an upper two-thirds holding a single bold claim or a tight row of two to three stat callouts in equal-width cells, and a lower third reserved for a supporting sub-statement or attribution line in a smaller weight. The signature accent strip bleeds edge-to-edge at the foot, carrying the batch tag flush-right. Hierarchy driven entirely by size contrast and a single horizontal rule separating claim band from sub-statement — no icons, no background shapes.
